name: External Charge Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the nature, or use, of the charges in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters.|The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

BRKF.name: Brokerage Fee
BRKF.definition: Fee paid to a broker for services provided.

BTCH.name: Batch
BTCH.definition: Fee paid for processing a batch of transactions.

AMND.name: Amendment
AMND.definition: Payment order was changed based on request to do so from the (original) sending bank or as a result of receiving amended information from the (original) sending bank.

CFEE.name: Cancellation Fee
CFEE.definition: Used when fees are assessed for cancellation of a payment.

CLEF.name: Clearing Fee
CLEF.definition: Used when fees are assessed for standard processing of financial institution type transfers.

INVS.name: Investigation
INVS.definition: Charges related to the processing of an investigation case/inquiry.

NSTP.name: Non STP Charges
NSTP.definition: Charge for a payment that required an intervention during processing.

DEBT.name: Borne By Debtor
DEBT.definition: Claim is being submitted in response to receiving a customer credit transfer with DEBT in Charge Bearer code.

TELE.name: Telecommunication Charges
TELE.definition: Charges relating to the most appropriate and efficient means of telecommunications available, for example, SWIFT, telex, telephone, facsimile, as determined by the party executing the payment instruction.
